captions: The Guildmaster asks the Scout to map how GET /users flows from route to query.
Across the guild: five deeds, mostly reading.
A quest leaves the board: the Architect is to design the pagination contract.
The Scout comes home: “routes.ts → service.ts → queries.ts; findUsers returns every…”
The Architect comes home: “Contract: ?cursor&limit → { items, nextCursor }. Two tasks…”
The Guildmaster sends the Artisan, the Artisan II and the Archivist out at once.
The Archivist comes home: “Use a row-value comparison: (created_at, id) > ($1, $2).”
The Artisan will go no further without your word.
The Artisan II's quest is done: “Route takes cursor & limit, encodes nextCursor.”
The Artisan returns with the loot: “findUsers(cursor, limit) with an index on (created_at, id).”
The Guildmaster sends the Warden to verify against the contract.
The Warden finds one failing.
The Warden returns with bad news: “FAIL: nextCursor skips the final row on exact page boundaries.”
The Guildmaster calls the Artisan back: “Fix: fetch limit + 1 to detect the next page”.
The Artisan's quest is done: “Lookahead row added; boundary test passes.”
A quest leaves the board: the Warden II is to re-verify.
The Warden II returns with good news: “PASS: contract holds, boundaries covered.”

legends.title: Add cursor pagination to GET /users
legends.opening: The Guildmaster took up the quest “Add cursor pagination to GET /users”, and sent seven adventurers out to see it done.

chapters.quest: Add cursor pagination to GET /users
Map how GET /users flows from route to query
chapters.loot: routes.ts → service.ts → queries.ts; findUsers returns every row.

chapters.quest: Design the pagination contract
chapters.loot: Contract: ?cursor&limit → { items, nextCursor }. Two tasks: API, query.

chapters.quest: API: parse cursor + limit, return nextCursor
chapters.loot: Route takes cursor & limit, encodes nextCursor.

chapters.quest: Query: keyset pagination on (created_at, id)

notables.text: Asked for your word; it was given after 7s.

chapters.loot: findUsers(cursor, limit) with an index on (created_at, id).

chapters.quest: Check the ORM's keyset API
chapters.loot: Use a row-value comparison: (created_at, id) > ($1, $2).

chapters.quest: Verify against the contract

notables.text: Tests failed: `bun test users`, 1 failing.

chapters.loot: FAIL: nextCursor skips the final row on exact page boundaries.

chapters.quest: Fix: fetch limit + 1 to detect the next page
chapters.loot: Lookahead row added; boundary test passes.

chapters.quest: Re-verify
chapters.loot: PASS: contract holds, boundaries covered.

legends.lastWord: GET /users now pages by cursor: ?cursor&limit → { items, nextCursor }. All 214 tests pass.
legends.closing: The quest was done in 1m 07s, though not without cost: one trial failed.

A sail with no crew, for those who fall…
What follows the storm, if the work comes good…
Spend long enough, and someone notices the treasury…
Count the deeds, and look up…
Fail the same trial three times running…

legends.title: Make Quill work offline: keep notes in IndexedDB, queue edits while offline…
legends.opening: The Guildmaster took up the quest “Make Quill work offline: keep notes in IndexedDB, queue edits while offline and sync…”, and sent ten adventurers out to see it done.

chapters.quest: Make Quill work offline: keep notes in IndexedDB, queue edits while offline and sync them when the connection returns. Conflicts must never lose text.
Map how notes are loaded and saved today
chapters.loot: Saves are a PUT /api/notes/:id from store.ts with no local copy; updatedAt is set by the server; useNotes refetches on window focus. Nothing queues a failed save, and nothing retries one.

chapters.quest: Research offline storage and sync in the browser
chapters.loot: IndexedDB via idb for notes and an outbox. Background Sync is Chromium-only: flush the outbox on `online`, on focus and on a timer. navigator.onLine lies; treat a failed fetch as offline.

chapters.quest: Design offline sync: storage, outbox, conflicts

notables.text: Asked for your word; it was given after 30s.

chapters.loot: Plan approved: (1) idb store + outbox, (2) sync engine with base versions and an op id per edit, (3) three-way merge for bodies, newest title wins, (4) an offline badge. Three can run at once.

chapters.quest: Storage: notes and the outbox in IndexedDB (src/sync/db.ts, src/sync/outbox.ts)
chapters.loot: Notes and the outbox live in IndexedDB; store.ts writes locally first and queues the edit.

chapters.quest: Sync engine: flush the outbox, pull changes since the last cursor (src/sync/engine.ts)
chapters.loot: Engine flushes the outbox in order and pulls since the cursor, with backoff on failure.

chapters.quest: Conflicts: three-way merge of note bodies (src/sync/conflict.ts)
chapters.loot: merge(base, local, remote): line-level diff3 for bodies; the newest title wins.

chapters.quest: Check idb's transaction API and how diff3 reports conflicts
chapters.loot: idb: never await a fetch inside a transaction (it auto-commits). diff3: merge() returns conflict hunks with both sides; keep them, don't pick one.

chapters.quest: Offline badge and pending-changes count in the header
chapters.loot: The header shows a quiet cloud badge with the pending count while offline.

chapters.quest: Service worker: cache the app shell so Quill opens with no network (src/sw/service-worker.ts)
chapters.loot: The app shell is precached: Quill opens with no network; /api stays network-first and /sync is never cached.

chapters.quest: Fix the emoji search bug: searching for “🍜 ramen” throws RangeError: Invalid code point in tokenize()
Find where search tokenizes note titles
chapters.loot: tokenize() slices titles by UTF-16 index; an emoji is a surrogate pair, the slice splits it and String.fromCodePoint throws.

chapters.quest: Reproduce with a failing test, then make tokenize() walk code points

chapters.quest: Drop Intl.Segmenter from indexer.ts: split words on Unicode whitespace instead
chapters.loot: indexer.ts splits on Unicode whitespace; no Intl.Segmenter.
